definition: [ צָנַף ] verb wrap, or wind up, together (compare Arabic hem of garment, ᵑ7 J צְנָפָא skirt ( = כָּנָף ); מַצְנֵפָא turban , Christian-Palestinian Aramaic tassel ); — Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular יִצְנֹף Lev 16:4 he shall wind (his head) with ( ב ) the turban ( מִצְנֶפֶת q. v.); suffix, + Infinitive absolute and accusative of congnate meaning with verb צָנוֺף יִצְנָפְךָ צְנֵפָה Isa 22:18 he will wind thee entirely up (with) a winding (under figure of ball, to be driven far off, in exile). — צנוף Isa 62:3 see following.
